\caption{Entropy in bits at the first generated token, means over $n\!=\!50$
prompts per arm, $-\log_2 R_t$ as the median. $\Delta H$ is the per-prompt shift
$H_{\text{post}} - H_{\text{pre}}$, a summary rather than a physical quantity
since the two entropies live on different supports. Larger $-\log_2 R_t$ means
less of the model's probability survives. $|A_t| = 5$ throughout, so
$H_{\text{post}} \le 2.32$. In the lower panel the pre-mask column sits below
$0.5$ and the post-mask column above it in every cell. Intervals are in the text.}
